title: 就 (jiù) in Chinese: Right Away, As Soon As: HSK 2 Grammar
description: How to use 就 (jiù) in Chinese: "right away", "sooner than expected", 一……就 for "as soon as", 就 for "then", common mistakes and HSK 2 examples.
h1: How to Use 就: "Right Away", "As Soon As" and "Then"
lede: 就 (jiù) is a short adverb with several jobs. It can mean "right away", show that something happened sooner than expected, join two actions as 一……就 ("as soon as"), or mean "then" after a condition. In every use, it goes straight before the verb.

paras: 就 before a verb says the action will happen very soon. It often comes after a time word such as 现在, 一会儿 or 很快. 我就来 is what you call out when someone is waiting for you.

examples.en: We'll be there in a moment.

examples.py: Nǐ děng yíxià, wǒ hěn kuài jiù hǎo.
examples.en: Wait a moment, I'll be ready soon.

paras: When 就 comes after a clock time or a length of time, it shows that something happened early or quickly, sooner than you might expect. For something that has already happened, put 了 at the end.
The opposite idea, "not until" or "only then", uses 才, an HSK 3 word.

examples.py: Tā qī diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
examples.en: He was up as early as seven.

examples.py: Huǒchē bā diǎn jiù kāi le.
examples.en: The train left as early as eight.

examples.py: Tā shí fēnzhōng jiù zuòwán le.
examples.en: He finished it in just ten minutes.

paras: Subject + 一 + action 1, (subject) + 就 + action 2.

The second action happens straight after the first. It can be a one-off event or something that happens every time. Both words go after their own subject and in front of the verb. If the two parts have different subjects, as in 他一来，我就走, each subject comes before its 一 or 就.
Remember the tone of 一: it is yí before a fourth tone (一到 yí dào, 一下班 yí xiàbān) and yì before the other tones (一来 yì lái).

examples.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
examples.py: Wǒ yí dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I get home.

examples.py: Tā měi tiān yí xiàbān jiù huí jiā.
examples.en: Every day he goes home as soon as he finishes work.

examples.py: Tā yí shàng chē jiù shuìzháo le.
examples.en: He fell asleep as soon as he got in the car.

examples.py: Tā yì lái, wǒ jiù zǒu.
examples.en: As soon as he arrives, I'll leave.

paras: 就 also links an action to what comes after it. After a first action, often verb + 了 + object, 就 says the second one follows straight on. After a condition, it works like "then" in "if... then", even when there is no word for "if" in the sentence.
那就 or 那我就 at the start of a reply means "in that case".

examples.zh: 我们吃了饭就去看电影。
examples.py: Wǒmen chī le fàn jiù qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.en: We'll go to the cinema after we eat.

examples.py: Nǐ dào le jiù gàosu wǒ.
examples.en: Let me know when you get there.

examples.py: Bù shūfu jiù huí jiā xiūxi ba.
examples.en: If you don't feel well, go home and rest.

examples.py: Nà wǒ jiù bú qù le.

paras: In English, "right away" and "then" can go at the end of a sentence. 就 never does: say 我就去, not 我去就. It always goes after the subject and straight before the verb.
With 一……就, learners often put 一 in front of the subject (一我到家) or leave 就 out. Say 他一下课就去打篮球, not 他一下课去打篮球. For something that has already happened, keep 了 at the end of the sentence.

examples.py: Tā yí xiàkè jiù qù dǎ lánqiú.
examples.en: He goes to play basketball as soon as class finishes.

examples.py: Tā yí kànjiàn wǒ jiù xiào le.
examples.en: She smiled as soon as she saw me.

worksheet.title: 就 and 一……就 Worksheet: HSK 2 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 就 (jiù) and 一……就 worksheet for HSK 2: 16 exercises (word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: He'll be back in a moment.
I drink coffee as soon as I get up.
He went home as soon as he finished work.
We finished eating in just ten minutes.
Call me when you get there.
We'll go to the shop after we eat.
As soon as I get tired, I want to sleep.
If you don't want to eat it, don't.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: I go and eat as soon as class finishes.
He went to bed as soon as he got home.
I drink water as soon as I get up.
She finished eating in just five minutes.
He goes home as soon as he finishes work.
Tell me when you get to the airport.
As soon as he comes in, I'll leave.
